captions.label: NailsSalon
captions.text: Try before you paint. A client snaps their hand, picks any nail photo, sees it painted on their own hand, and sends the recipe to their salon.

captions.label: Step 1 · Hand photo
captions.text: A hand-tracking model runs on the phone and checks the shot live: one hand, flat, all five nails, sharp, well lit.

captions.label: Step 1 · Hand photo
captions.text: The photo is taken automatically once every check passes. Nothing is uploaded before that.

captions.label: Step 2 · Inspiration
captions.text: Pick any nail photo: a screenshot, Instagram, Pinterest or the camera roll.

captions.label: Step 2 · Reading the design
captions.text: The app finds the five nails and reads each one on its own: colour, finish, pattern, shape and length. A per-finger spec, not a picture to copy.

captions.label: Length & shape
captions.text: Extensions, almond, long. Every part of the look can be changed before anything is rendered.

captions.label: Finish
captions.text: The finish of each nail, read from the photo. Tap to change it.

captions.label: Step 3 · Rendering
captions.text: The spec goes to the YouCam AI Nail Virtual Try-On API: one call, every finger with its own colour, finish and art, on the client's real hand.

captions.label: Step 3 · Rendering
captions.text: Three stages: reading the hand, painting the five nails, then matching the salon's polishes.

captions.label: The result
captions.text: Before and after, on the client's own hand. Drag the slider to compare.

captions.label: YouCam Nail Transfer
captions.text: A second render for comparison: the YouCam AI Nail Transfer API copies the whole photo onto the hand.

captions.label: Approximate
captions.text: The app labels this one as approximate, since the photo is copied as a whole, and offers to render each finger exactly instead.

captions.label: From the salon's shelf
captions.text: Every nail matched to a polish the salon actually stocks, by colour difference, with a price and chair time from the salon's own price list.

captions.label: The recipe card
captions.text: One tap sends the recipe to the salon on WhatsApp. Nail by nail: polish, finish, shape, length, the hand photo and the price.

footer: Built on the YouCam AI Nail Virtual Try-On and AI Nail Transfer APIs
